summary.text: Val Applewhite is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 19, covering Cumberland County, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Venus de la Cruz.
She is a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Applewhite has represented District 19 since January 1, 2023, succeeding Kirk deViere, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as real estate broker.
The Democratic primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.

The General Assembly's website shows her committee assignments in Appropriations on Education/Higher Education, Appropriations/Base Budget, Finance, Health Care, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and State and Local Government, along with membership on the Environmental Review Commission and the Joint Legislative Emergency Management Oversight Committee.
